description: POST broken or LLM-truncated JSON (max 16 KB). Returns valid JSON plus an ordered list of fixes: code fences, comments, single quotes, bare keys, trailing or missing commas, Python literals and unclosed strings, arrays or objects. Valid input is returned unchanged. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: json_repair
title: Johto Data JSON Repair
